# aspect-ratio

Native aspectRatio guidance.

![aspect-ratio preview](../images/items/aspect-ratio-light.png)

More previews: [dark](../images/items/aspect-ratio-dark.png)

Nothing to install. Copy the snippet below

## Usage

```swift
Color.indigo
    .overlay {
        Image(systemName: "play.fill")
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
    .aspectRatio(16.0 / 9.0, contentMode: .fit)
    .accessibilityLabel("Video placeholder")

Color.teal
    .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
    .frame(maxWidth: 160)
    .accessibilityLabel("Avatar placeholder")
```

## Why native is enough

`aspectRatio(_:contentMode:)` at call site; no wrapper; preserves parent layout proposals.
